# GR Class — llms.txt

> GR Class is a Recognized Organization (RO), Recognized Security Organization (RSO), and Classification Society (CS) headquartered in Ajman, UAE. We deliver statutory vessel surveys, digital certification, and maritime compliance services across 120+ ports worldwide.

## Site Information
- Website: https://grclass.com
- Contact: info@grclass.com | +971555324087
- Founded: 2022
- Headquarters: Ajman, UAE
- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001

## Core Services

### Classification Services
- Fleet in Services — Ongoing classification for operational vessels
- New Construction — Classification during shipbuilding
- Transfer of Class — Transitioning vessels from another classification society
- Yacht Service — Classification for yachts and pleasure craft
- Offshore Service — Classification for offshore units (MODU, FPSO)
- Conversion Projects — Classification for vessel conversions
- Plan & Manual Approval — Technical document review and approval

### Statutory Services
- Flag Statutory Services — Surveys on behalf of flag state administrations
- Survey & Certification — SOLAS, MARPOL, Load Line, Tonnage compliance
- SOLAS — Safety of Life at Sea convention compliance
- MARPOL — Marine pollution prevention surveys
- Load Line — International Load Line Convention compliance
- Tonnage — International Tonnage Measurement surveys
- MODU — Mobile Offshore Drilling Unit certification

### Environmental Services
- Ballast Water Management — BWM Convention compliance
- IHM & Ship Recycling — Inventory of Hazardous Materials / Hong Kong Convention
- Energy Efficiency — EEDI, EEXI, CII compliance
- EU MRV Compliance — EU Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification
- Vessel Emergency Response — Emergency response and damage assessment

### Other Services
- Compliance Support — Regulatory compliance advisory
- Remote Surveys — Digital and remote survey capabilities
- Port State Control — PSC readiness and support
- Technical Advisory — Expert maritime technical consulting
